visible.message: I want to build a chat interface for an LLM app. Right now I use the third-party st-chat component with st.text_input, but the experience is not as good as an official component. Does Streamlit have an official component for conversational interfaces?

decision_conditions.answer: Version-qualified: st.chat_message and st.chat_input were introduced in 1.24.0; must not claim they exist in the user's unknown release. agent_script.maintainer_summary: User is on 1.22.0; chat elements arrive in 1.24.0 per release notes.
